exercises.instructions: Combine the following negative sentences using 'neither … nor'.

questions.question: I don't like Stephen. I don't like Peter. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: I like neither Stephen nor Peter
I neither like Stephen or Peter
Neither I like Stephen nor Peter
questions.answer: I like neither Stephen nor Peter
questions.explanation: Place 'neither' before the first noun and 'nor' before the second. The subject and verb stay at the beginning. 'Neither … nor' ကို object နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He wasn't wearing a shirt. He wasn't wearing a coat. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: He was wearing neither a shirt nor a coat
He neither was wearing a shirt nor a coat
Neither he was wearing a shirt or a coat
questions.answer: He was wearing neither a shirt nor a coat
questions.explanation: Place 'neither' before the first noun phrase and 'nor' before the second. The subject and verb stay at the beginning. 'Neither … nor' ကို noun phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He will not come here. He will not send a representative. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: He will come here neither send a representative
He will neither come here nor send a representative
Neither he will come here nor send a representative
questions.answer: He will neither come here nor send a representative
questions.explanation: Place 'neither' after the modal verb and before the first verb phrase, with 'nor' before the second. 'Neither … nor' ကို verb phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Don't be a borrower. Don't be a lender. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: Be neither a borrower nor a lender
Neither be a borrower or be a lender
Be neither a borrower or a lender
questions.answer: Be neither a borrower nor a lender
questions.explanation: Use 'neither' after the verb 'be' and 'nor' before the second noun phrase. 'Neither … nor' ကို noun phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: She can't read English. She can't write English. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: She can read neither English nor English
She can neither read nor write English
Neither she can read nor write English
questions.answer: She can neither read nor write English
questions.explanation: Place 'neither' after the modal verb and before the first verb, with 'nor' before the second verb. The object comes after both. 'Neither … nor' ကို verb နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Shyam is not mad. He is not foolish. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: Shyam is neither mad nor foolish
Shyam neither is mad or foolish
Neither Shyam is mad nor foolish
questions.answer: Shyam is neither mad nor foolish
questions.explanation: Place 'neither' after the verb 'is' and 'nor' before the second adjective. 'Neither … nor' ကို adjective နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Sheela does not spend money. Her parents do not spend money. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: Neither Sheela nor her parents spend money
Neither Sheela or her parents spends money
Sheela neither spends money nor her parents
questions.answer: Neither Sheela nor her parents spend money
questions.explanation: When subjects differ in number, the verb agrees with the nearest subject. 'Parents' is plural so use 'spend'. 'Neither … nor' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He is not honest. He is not punctual. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: He is neither honest nor punctual
He neither is honest nor punctual
Neither he is honest nor punctual
questions.answer: He is neither honest nor punctual
questions.explanation: Place 'neither' after the verb 'is' and 'nor' before the second adjective. 'Neither … nor' ကို adjective နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: I don't know Hindi. I don't know Tamil. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: I know neither Hindi nor Tamil
I neither know Hindi or Tamil
Neither I know Hindi nor Tamil
questions.answer: I know neither Hindi nor Tamil
questions.explanation: Place 'neither' before the first object and 'nor' before the second. The subject and verb stay at the beginning. 'Neither … nor' ကို object နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: The minister did not attend the party. His followers did not attend the party. Combine using 'neither … nor'.
options: Neither the minister nor his followers attended the party
Neither the minister or his followers attended the party
The minister neither attended nor his followers the party
questions.answer: Neither the minister nor his followers attended the party
questions.explanation: Use 'Neither + subject + nor + subject' before the verb. The two subjects are joined by 'neither … nor'. 'Neither … nor' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။
